title.text: Productivity growth and the change in churn, GDP-deflated
subtitle: Change in GVA per hour (GDP-deflated) against change in the job reallocation rate between consecutive periods.
GVA per hour in current prices deflated by the UK GDP deflator (2022 prices). Red line = fit across all regions, navy = excluding London. NI excluded where the earlier window starts before 2011.
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS Subregional productivity (June 2025); authors' calculations.
